label: COMPUTED; observational, cross-sectional association; not a causal estimate
source: FinScope Tanzania 2023, respondent-level; survey weight population_wt; design RECONSTRUCTED (PSU = enumeration area, strata = region x cluster type)
population: descriptives: all 9,915 adult respondents; models: the 9911 with a stated education level
outcome: holds a Taxpayer Identification Number (c27__13 = Yes)
disclosure_rule: unweighted numerators below 10 are not published and the estimate is flagged low_precision; bases below 10 are suppressed

covariates: residence (Dar es Salaam / other urban / rural / Zanzibar)
region (each region of mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar; in the headline model only)
main income source (no income amount exists in FinScope 2023; it also carries business ownership, which BusO derives from it)
model_specification.covariates_note: these are the covariates of the headline model reported here (headline_model); the other model is the same without region
model_specification.estimator: survey-weighted logistic regression, Firth-penalised (Jeffreys prior with weighted information), because almost no non-user holds a TIN
model_specification.standard_errors: Taylor-linearised sandwich, PSU totals within strata (reconstructed design), t intervals

average_marginal_effect_of_mobile_money.label: COMPUTED; observational, cross-sectional association; not a causal estimate

unpenalised_comparison.note: the unpenalised weighted logit is shown only to document near-separation (a very large coefficient or non-convergence); it is not used

replaces: the simulated propensity-score matching (planted 6 pp effect; reported 9.0 / 5.94 pp), the typed difference-in-differences and the typed synthetic control, all retired in Block D2
